correctness.rationale: For the connected crown H_n n>=3, ordinary graph distances distinguish same-index endpoint by 3, same-side distinct indices by 2, and opposite-side unmatched by 1. Every resolving set meets at least n-1 pairs; exactly one-hole transversals of n-1 matched pairs form all metric bases. Legal slides swap the hole with an occupied index and flip the selected side at the old hole. Thus there are n·2^(n-1) states, degree n-1. An induction freezing a shared token, plus explicit n+3-step same-hole complement route and n+2-step no-common unequal-hole route, prove all-pairs upper bound n+3; to reverse all n-1 signs and restore the same hole requires at least two reverse-color slides, giving matching lower bound. Independently constructed the entire vacancy-side graph and performed BFS from every state for n=3..7, giving diameters 6,7,8,9,10, including the C12 base case. The source artifacts/verify_state.py paths were inspected; finite BFS corroborates, not proves, all n.
residual_risks: Finite BFS n<=7 cannot certify diameter for arbitrary n; the induction and lower-count proof are essential.
